record_title: Critical damping closure and sharp algebraic decay for the Thomas cyclic flow
provenance: A global Lyapunov inequality and sharp critical-rate theorem for the cyclic Thomas ordinary differential equation in arbitrary finite dimension.
limitations: The theorem does not classify the subcritical attractor structure. The critical constants are sharp worst-case limsup bounds, not universal trajectory-wise asymptotic constants. Thomas (1999) and parts of the higher-dimensional literature were not fully inspected, leaving a residual originality risk; originality is to the best of our knowledge.
